headline: 2Q beat led by strong growth across brands

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Honasa Consumer 2Q beat led by strong growth across brands Consumer Goods  Result Update  November 08, 2026 CMP (Rs): 465 | TP (Rs): 575 Honasa’s 2QFY27 was a strong quarter, with a beat on all fronts.
Revenue grew 36% yoy (highest in a quarter since listing), 6% above consensus’ estimate, led by 31% volume growth.
EBITDA nearly doubled yoy (16% beat) and adj PAT grew 86% (12% beat).
Growth was broad-based, with focus categories (>80% of sales) growing >40%, Mamaearth sustained its high-teens growth and younger brands grew >45% (>40% ex-Derma Co).
valuation: Management expects EBITDA margin to maintain current levels even in 2H and believes it is on track to achieve its 15% target over coming 4Y.

Sheth’s proposition is being re-looked to target actives consumers. ⏹ BBlunt hair colour grew >100% post-relaunch, and styling is faring well on QC; the care range will be relaunched, and Honasa plans to enter the hair color space with another brand.
